ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a ratio of approximately 85% dark pixels to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips and leading margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central area consists of a contiguous low-intensity black mass; high-intensity white blobs are mapped to the extreme lateral tips (coordinates 0,100 and 100,100 relative) and along the anterior boundaries; sparse white punctate clusters are visible in the medial-left quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (1-4 pixel) serrations along the entire boundary; distinctive macro-indentation visible on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 60% lateral from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the anterior margin; trailing edge displays a multi-inflection curve with localized concavity approaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixels at the lateral tips suggesting localized surface disruptions; scattered circular white aggregates (2-5 pixel diameter) in the lower-central black field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single vertical high-intensity linear pixel disruption extending from the median notch base toward the fluke center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion and non-symmetrical trailing edge profile on the right lobe relative to the left lobe.
